Junior Quality Analyst

Closing date :30-11-2026

Email : info@tranetech.com

Job Description

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
    Experience : Freshers are allowed
    Please share the resume to hr.admin@tranetech.ae
    Contact number : 9074289496

    •Analyse business requirements and prepare test cases, test plans, and test scenarios
    •Perform manual and/or automated testing on web and mobile applications
    •Identify, document, and track bugs using appropriate tools
    •Collaborate with developers and product teams to resolve issues
    •Conduct regression, functional, and performance testing
    •Ensure product quality before deployment
    •Maintain proper documentation of test results and reports

Job Skills

  • • Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and QA methodologies
    •Experience in manual testing (automation is an added advantage)
    •Familiarity with bug tracking tools like JIRA, Bugzilla, etc.
    •Basic understanding of SQL and databases
    •Knowledge of API testing tools (like Postman) is a plus
    •Good analytical and problem-solving skills
    •Strong communication and teamwork abilities
    •Experience in ERP Software will be an added advantage
